title: elymus donianus subsp. virescens
intro: Elymus donianus subsp. virescens, commonly known as the green-leaved wild ryegrass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elymus donianus subsp. virescens include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis, ulcers, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
